Intelerad manages over 50 billion medical images and supports more than 300,000 clinicians who conduct over 140 million exams annually on its platform.

The company has grown through strategic acquisitions and investments, enhancing its offerings with solutions like IntelePACS® and InteleViewer™. Intelerad focuses on innovation, including AI-driven worklist prioritization and zero-footprint viewing tools, to improve clinician workflows and patient outcomes. It serves nearly 2,500 healthcare organizations globally, including radiology groups, hospitals, and outpatient imaging centers.

Founded in 1998, the company employs around 1,000 people and generates approximately $210.1 million in annual revenue. The company offers AI-powered EAM solutions that enhance asset performance and operational efficiency. Key products include RapidAPM, an AI diagnostics solution that delivers results significantly faster, and GWOS-AI, an advanced planning and scheduling tool. Prometheus Group serves over 200 blue-chip customers globally, achieving notable results in maintenance efficiency and productivity for clients like DTE Energy and Hemlock Semiconductor.

It specializes in statistical analysis and process improvement tools, aiming to make data-driven decisions accessible for quality improvement and process optimization. Headquartered in State College, Pennsylvania, Minitab has grown significantly and now employs between 501 and 1000 people, with subsidiaries in several countries including the Netherlands, UK, France, Germany, Hong Kong, Japan, and Australia.

Minitab's flagship product is Minitab Statistical Software, which supports data analysis, Six Sigma, and quality control. Minitab provides training services and expert support to help users enhance their analysis capabilities. With over 90% of Fortune 100 companies using its software, Minitab has established itself as a leading tool in academia and various industries for process improvement and statistical learning.

Wing Aviation LLC, a subsidiary of Alphabet Inc., specializes in drone delivery services. The company uses lightweight, autonomous drones to transport small packages quickly, with a focus on items like medicine and food. Since its inception as a project at Google X in 2012, Wing has completed over 500,000 commercial flights across multiple continents, including Australia, Europe, and the United States.

Wing's fleet of hybrid drones can deliver packages weighing up to 2.5 lbs and operate efficiently with advanced automation and intelligent navigation systems. The drones are designed for rapid delivery, with capabilities for 20 km round trips and speeds of up to 130 km/h. Wing offers on-demand delivery services that integrate seamlessly into existing logistics, allowing businesses to deliver a variety of items directly to customers' doorsteps. Partnerships with retailers like Walmart and Serve Robotics enhance their service offerings, expanding the reach and efficiency of last-mile delivery.

It operates 24/7 from global hubs and collaborates closely with Google for expert-led implementation and support. Key leadership includes Raju Chekuri as chairman, president, and CEO, along with Praveen Hebbagodi as CTO and Chris Morales as CISO.

ThetaRay is an AI-powered financial crime compliance platform based in Hod Hasharon, Israel. Founded in 2013, the company focuses on helping banks, fintechs, and other financial institutions detect and prevent financial crimes. Using Cognitive AI technology, ThetaRay enables institutions to identify legitimate customers while flagging suspicious activities, addressing critical issues like human trafficking and drug trafficking.

The company offers three main solutions: Transaction Monitoring, which analyzes fund flows to detect suspicious behaviors; Transaction & Customer Screening, which verifies transactions and customers in real-time; and Client Risk Assessment, a holistic risk management product launched in 2023. ThetaRay serves over 100 institutional customers and monitors more than $20 trillion in transactions annually, achieving significant growth and uncovering more suspicious activity compared to traditional systems. The company recently raised $57 million to support its global expansion and meet the increasing demand for advanced financial crime detection technology.

Beacon Biosignals is a neurotechnology company based in Boston, Massachusetts, founded in 2019. The company focuses on applying artificial intelligence to electroencephalography (EEG) data to enhance precision medicine for neurological and psychiatric conditions. Its mission is to transform the diagnosis, treatment, and understanding of these conditions by leveraging advanced AI technology and deep biopharma expertise.

The primary offering from Beacon is its AI-powered EEG biomarker platform, which detects unique EEG signatures that are not identifiable by humans. This platform is trained on over 200,000 hours of EEG data and supports various applications in drug development, including translational research and clinical trials. Additionally, Beacon provides a clinical-grade, FDA-cleared sleep EEG headband for collecting high-fidelity sleep data, along with full-service clinical trial support that includes device setup and data management. The company has established partnerships with major pharmaceutical firms, such as Takeda and Skye Bioscience, to advance research and clinical trials in brain health.

CodeWeavers is a software company based in St. Paul, Minnesota, founded in 1996. The company specializes in Windows compatibility solutions for Mac, Linux, and ChromeOS platforms. It is the leading developer of Wine, an open-source project that allows Windows applications to run on Unix-like operating systems without needing a Windows installation or virtual machines. CodeWeavers is the principal corporate sponsor of the Wine project and employs many key developers, including its primary maintainer.

The company's flagship product, CrossOver, enables users to run Windows software on Mac, Linux, and ChromeOS without purchasing a Windows license. Additionally, CodeWeavers offers PortJump, a service that assists developers in porting Windows applications to Mac and Linux, and ExecMode, a consulting service focused on software compatibility and porting. With a global customer base across 182 countries, CodeWeavers supports individual users, businesses, and organizations in need of Windows application compatibility. The company is also actively involved in the open-source community and has partnerships with notable entities like Google and Valve.

Mozilla is a global open-source software organization dedicated to promoting openness, innovation, and opportunity on the internet. Founded in 1998, it began when Netscape Communications Corporation released its browser suite source code, allowing programmers worldwide to contribute. Mozilla operates through two main entities: the Mozilla Foundation, a non-profit organization, and the Mozilla Corporation, a subsidiary that manages commercial operations.

Mozilla's flagship product is the Firefox browser, a free and open-source web browser that emphasizes user choice and control. Other notable products include Thunderbird, an email client, and the Mozilla Developer Center, which provides resources for web standards and development. Mozilla also supports community initiatives, offering grants for web accessibility improvements and exploring new technology areas like Mozilla.ai. The organization thrives on collaboration, with thousands of volunteers contributing to its projects and initiatives globally.

The company has also expanded its offerings through strategic acquisitions, enhancing its asset management and security features. With over $400 million in funding and a valuation of $2.56 billion, JumpCloud continues to grow and innovate in the identity management space.

Matterport is a spatial data company based in Sunnyvale, California, founded in 2011. The company specializes in creating immersive 3D digital twins of physical spaces using advanced computer vision, AI, and cloud technology. Matterport's solutions enable users to transform buildings and environments into actionable data, supporting various applications throughout the building lifecycle, including design, construction, operations, marketing, and restoration.

Matterport's core offerings include 3D capture and reconstruction, secure cloud storage for 3D data, and AI-powered enhancements for model accuracy. With a strong presence in industries such as real estate, architecture, engineering, and hospitality, Matterport has digitized over 12 million spaces worldwide, facilitating digital transformation across property lifecycles.

AST SpaceMobile is a satellite communications company focused on creating a space-based cellular broadband network that connects directly to everyday smartphones. Founded in May 2017 by Abel Avellan in Midland, Texas, the company operates extensive manufacturing facilities and is publicly traded on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol ASTS. Its mission is to bridge connectivity gaps for mobile subscribers worldwide, aiming to provide broadband access to billions who currently lack it.

The company's primary product is the BlueBird satellite constellation, designed to deliver 4G and 5G connectivity without the need for specialized hardware. AST SpaceMobile has launched several satellites, including the BlueWalker 3 prototype, which successfully demonstrated 5G capabilities from space. The company partners with major mobile network operators like AT&T and Verizon to integrate its technology into existing networks, covering over 1.8 billion mobile subscribers globally. With a significant market potential and a strong portfolio of patents, AST SpaceMobile is positioned to lead in space-based cellular broadband technology.

Consensus is an AI-powered academic search engine that helps researchers quickly find, understand, and synthesize scientific literature. It searches over 200 million academic papers, focusing on peer-reviewed journal articles, conference papers, and preprints. The platform aggregates data from Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, and its own scholarly web crawl, ensuring comprehensive coverage of high-impact journals and PubMed.

Users can access Pro Analysis tools for outlines, technical reports, and rapid reviews. Consensus also allows users to manage literature effectively, enhancing technical reports and literature reviews. Additionally, the Consensus Meter evaluates research consensus on specific topics. The service caters to various industries, including biotech, healthcare, and academia, and offers flexible pricing for individuals, small teams, and larger organizations, along with an API for enterprise integration.

Scribd, Inc. is a digital platform based in San Francisco, California, founded in 2007. Initially created for document sharing, Scribd has evolved into a comprehensive service that includes e-book and audiobook subscriptions, along with a variety of related offerings. The platform hosts 60 million user-uploaded documents and serves 80 million users, providing resources for teachers, professionals, and enthusiasts.

Scribd offers a subscription service that grants unlimited access to over one million titles, including e-books, audiobooks, sheet music, and comic books from more than 1,000 publishers. In 2023, Scribd launched Everand, a brand focused on premium literary content, and integrated SlideShare for presentation sharing. The company has established partnerships with major publishers and media outlets, enhancing its diverse content offerings and positioning itself as a go-to resource for readers and researchers alike.

Anuvu is a prominent provider of connectivity and entertainment solutions tailored for the aviation and maritime industries. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Santa Ana, California, the company delivers broadband internet, content licensing, and related services to improve experiences for passengers and crew on airlines, cruise lines, yachts, and commercial vessels. Anuvu also supports mission-critical applications in the energy and government sectors.

The company operates two main divisions: Media Technology Services and Connectivity. Media Technology Services licenses and distributes a vast library of entertainment content, while the Connectivity division offers telecommunications equipment, high-speed satellite internet, and analytics solutions. Anuvu's integrated offerings enhance inflight and onboard connectivity, providing a wide range of entertainment options and optimizing passenger experiences. With a strong global presence, Anuvu serves over 150 airlines and 30 cruise lines, focusing on delivering reliable and scalable solutions that align with customer brands.

Opensignal is a global provider of independent analytics and insights focused on mobile network experiences and market performance. Founded in 2010 and based in Boston, Massachusetts, the company analyzes billions of data points daily to deliver insights that help telecommunications providers enhance network and subscriber performance. 

Opensignal specializes in network performance measurement, consumer and business subscriber behavior analysis, and sales operations support across various ecosystems. The company offers the OpenSignal app, which helps users find better phone signals and measures data speed and reliability. Additionally, Opensignal has developed several complementary applications, including WeatherSignal for real-time weather data, CrisisSignal for monitoring communication network status during emergencies, and WifiMapper for locating free Wi-Fi hotspots.

Opensignal serves major telecom companies worldwide and collaborates with media organizations to create interactive coverage maps. The company is backed by Berkshire Partners and has received investment from notable firms, including Qualcomm Ventures.

Level Access specializes in software and services that help organizations create accessible and legally compliant websites, mobile apps, and digital experiences, adhering to standards such as ADA, WCAG, and Section 508.

The company offers a range of solutions, including software platforms for automated testing and remediation, Accessibility-as-a-Service, and consulting and training services. Level Access serves over 1,000 clients, including corporations, government agencies, and educational institutions, helping them deliver barrier-free digital experiences. The company has achieved significant milestones, including becoming the first digital accessibility-only firm to surpass $100 million in annual recurring revenue and earning recognition as a leader in the field. Level Access also fosters an inclusive workplace culture, employing many individuals with disabilities and supporting professional development initiatives.

It offers a high-performance, software-defined data platform that unifies unstructured data across on-premises, hybrid cloud, and multi-cloud environments. The Hammerspace Data Platform features a unified data plane and global namespace, allowing for multi-protocol support and data-in-place access. It automates data services with objectives-based policies for data placement and protection, and it enhances data orchestration for high-performance computing. The platform is built on open standards and supports deployment as installable software or hardware appliances, ensuring compatibility with various infrastructures.

Hammerspace serves multiple industries, including Media & Entertainment, Life Sciences, Public Sector, Financial Services, Game Development, Higher Education, and Enterprise IT. Its solutions are utilized by notable customers such as Meta and the U.S. Department of Defense, addressing the challenges of AI and unstructured data.

Solifi serves banks, captives, and independent finance organizations worldwide, helping them achieve growth and efficiency through its technology. The company also offers professional services for data migration and project management, ensuring a smooth transition to cloud systems.

The Central Florida Regional Transportation Authority, known as LYNX, is the public transit agency for Orange, Osceola, and Seminole Counties in Central Florida. Established in 1972, LYNX operates a wide range of transportation services across approximately 2,500 square miles, serving a population of over 1.8 million. The agency offers around 68 fixed-route bus services, a fare-free Bus Rapid Transit system called LYMMO in downtown Orlando, and various flexible and express services to meet the needs of the community.

LYNX also provides a door-to-door paratransit service for individuals with disabilities and vanpool options for commuters. The agency maintains five major transit hubs and utilizes compressed natural gas for a significant portion of its fleet. With over 60,000 weekday rides and nearly 20 million passenger trips in the fiscal year 2024, LYNX plays a vital role in connecting residents, businesses, and visitors throughout the region.

Launched in November 2017 and based in San Francisco, Replika was founded by Eugenia Kuyda, inspired by her experience of creating a chatbot from a friend's text messages after their passing. The app has grown significantly, reaching over 40 million users by 2025.

Replika operates on a freemium model, allowing users to create a personalized AI companion through a series of questions. Key features include text-based conversations, mood tracking, and emotional support, all designed to enhance users' emotional well-being. The app is available on multiple platforms, and about 25% of users opt for an annual subscription. Additionally, Replika has applications in customer engagement, demonstrating improved response times and customer satisfaction for businesses. The company prioritizes user privacy, ensuring that conversations remain confidential and are not shared with third parties.

Creators of the Irth app and the Birthright podcast. We're a tech & media non-profit that shifts the narrative in Black maternal and infant health by shifting the narrator! Join the narrative nation!

Originally named Medgate, the company began by providing occupational health software and has since expanded its offerings to support sustainable performance across various industries.

Cority's comprehensive platform includes occupational health and industrial hygiene software, environmental management solutions, chemical safety tools, ergonomics software, quality management systems, and risk management capabilities. The platform also features incident management, auditing functions, and sustainability reporting solutions. Cority serves a wide range of industries, including oil and gas, chemicals, food and beverage, utilities, manufacturing, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, and mining. The company has received multiple industry recognitions and continues to grow, reflecting its commitment to enhancing EHSQ practices globally.

QNX is a commercial real-time operating system (RTOS) designed for embedded systems, founded in 1980 in Ottawa, Canada. Originally established as Quantum Software Systems, it has evolved into a business unit of BlackBerry Limited, focusing on safe and secure software for mission-critical applications. QNX is known for its microkernel architecture, which allows for efficient task scheduling and message passing, making it suitable for a wide range of industries.

The company offers a variety of products, including the QNX Neutrino RTOS, safety-certified software, and middleware solutions. These products emphasize reliability and security, catering to sectors such as automotive, medical devices, telecommunications, and aerospace. QNX's software is utilized in over a million systems worldwide, supporting applications in vehicles, manufacturing, healthcare, and more. The company also provides professional services, training, and support to help clients achieve compliance and enhance their embedded systems.

MEDFAR Clinical Solutions is a healthcare technology company based in Montreal, Quebec, founded in 2010 by Elias Farah and Patrick Issid. The company specializes in cloud-based electronic medical record (EMR) and electronic health record (EHR) solutions designed to enhance clinical workflows and improve care efficiency across North America. MEDFAR has developed a range of SaaS-based platforms that help reduce administrative burdens for medical practices, allowing physicians to focus more on patient care.

The company's core offerings include the MYLE Integrated Care Platform, which provides comprehensive EMR capabilities for primary care clinics, and PLEXIA EMR, tailored for specialists. MEDFAR also offers additional solutions through acquisitions, such as LABGEN for laboratory information management and revenue cycle management software. With over 15,000 healthcare professionals using its systems, MEDFAR is recognized as Canada's fastest-growing EMR provider, aiming to support 5 million providers and 500 million patients globally by 2030.

Safe Software is a software company based in Surrey, British Columbia, founded in 1993 by Don Murray and Dale Lutz. The company specializes in spatial data integration through its flagship platform, FME (Feature Manipulation Engine). This platform allows organizations to process, convert, and exchange data across incompatible systems, serving industries such as government, utilities, energy, and engineering.

With over 300 employees and a growing global presence, Safe Software serves more than 25,000 customers and 200,000 users across 121-128 countries. The company has achieved B Corp certification in 2024, reflecting its commitment to social and environmental performance. Its core offerings include various tools within the FME platform, such as FME Form for building data workflows, FME Flow for automation, and FME Mobile for field data collection. Safe Software also provides consulting services and maintains a robust partner ecosystem for implementation across various disciplines.

Giro's philosophy centers on creating products that foster personal expression and support freedom in riding, making it a preferred choice for riders worldwide, including enthusiasts and Olympic athletes.

Commvault Systems, Inc. is a data protection and resilience company based in Tinton Falls, New Jersey. Founded in 1988 as a part of Bell Labs and becoming independent in 1996, Commvault has over 25 years of experience in helping organizations protect, recover, and manage their data across various platforms and environments. The company has evolved from providing backup solutions to offering a unified resilience platform that addresses the challenges of growing data volumes and cyber threats.

Commvault's core offerings include Intelligent Data Services, which can be deployed on-premises, in the cloud, or as managed services. Key products include Commvault Cloud, a cloud-native platform for data security and recovery, and Metallic, an enterprise-grade SaaS portfolio for Backup-as-a-Service. The company emphasizes innovation, holding over 1,500 patents and being recognized as a leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Backup and Data Protection Platforms. Commvault serves a diverse range of leading organizations, focusing on resilience against breaches and disasters while maintaining a commitment to sustainability.

The core of the Elastic Stack includes Elasticsearch, a distributed search and analytics engine, along with Logstash and Beats for data ingestion, and Kibana for visualization. This platform is designed for high scalability and resilience, offering deployment options on-premises, in public or private clouds, and as serverless solutions. Elastic serves a diverse range of industries, including technology, healthcare, and finance, and is trusted by many leading organizations worldwide. Its offerings include search solutions, observability tools, security features, and a versatile Search AI Platform that integrates generative AI and machine learning capabilities.

Posit PBC is an open-source data science software company based in Boston, Massachusetts. Founded in 2009 as RStudio Inc., the company rebranded in 2022 to reflect its expansion beyond R programming to include Python and other languages. As a Public Benefit Corporation and Certified B Corporation, Posit focuses on creating free and open-source software that enhances data science, scientific research, and technical communication.

Posit develops a range of widely-used open-source tools, including Shiny, RMarkdown, and support for Jupyter Notebooks. Their commercial offerings include Posit Workbench, Posit Connect, and Posit Package Manager, which facilitate collaboration and organization in data science projects. The company also provides cloud solutions and recently introduced Positron, a data science code editor aimed at improving workflows. Posit serves a diverse audience, including academia, small businesses, and large enterprises, and emphasizes community engagement through events like rstudio::conf.

Palmetto State Armory (PSA) is a firearms manufacturer and retailer based in Columbia, South Carolina. Founded in 2008 by Jamin McCallum, an Iraq War veteran, PSA started as an online retailer and has grown into a vertically integrated company. It emphasizes affordable, American-made products and offers an unlimited lifetime warranty on its firearms. E-commerce accounts for 85% of its business, supported by a streamlined fulfillment process.

PSA manufactures a range of firearms, including AR-15 rifles, AK-47s, and pistols, along with build kits, parts, and shooting accessories. The company has expanded its operations through acquisitions and focuses on in-house production to keep costs low. In addition to its online presence, PSA operates retail stores in Georgia, North Carolina, and South Carolina, with plans for further expansion, including stores with firing ranges.

The company specializes in telecommunications software products and SaaS solutions tailored for communications service providers (CSPs) and media enterprises. With a mission to enhance digital commerce and customer experience, LotusFlare focuses on AI-powered features that streamline technology and operations.

The core offering, LotusFlare DNO™ Cloud, is a cloud-native business support system (BSS) that adheres to TM Forum Open Digital Architecture standards. It provides a range of functionalities, including product catalog management, billing, and payment management, all designed for flexibility and scalability. Additional products include LotusFlare Charging, an AI-powered charging system, and Nomad, a mobile app for purchasing eSIM products. The platform's microservices architecture allows for dynamic scaling and hyper-personalized user experiences. 

LotusFlare serves prominent global clients such as Deutsche Telekom, Verizon, and Singtel, among others.

The company has developed the world's first ALL G unified software platform for Open RAN architecture, which supports 2G, 3G, 4G, and 5G networks. Parallel Wireless operates on six continents, has received over 55 industry awards, and employs around 685 people, generating approximately $253.1 million in revenue. The leadership team includes experienced professionals with extensive backgrounds in wireless and telecom technologies.

Mapbox is a location intelligence platform that provides cloud-based APIs, SDKs, and data services for maps, navigation, and place search. Founded in 2010 and headquartered in San Francisco, the company aims to empower developers and businesses to create location-aware applications. Mapbox began by addressing limitations in existing mapping solutions and has since partnered with organizations like the United Nations and World Bank on various projects.

The company offers a range of services, including customizable mapping and navigation APIs, a design tool called Mapbox Studio, and geocoding services across 157 countries. Mapbox also features AI-powered navigation solutions and recently introduced MapGPT, an AI-driven mapping tool. With a strong technological foundation, Mapbox integrates real-time data and advanced rendering technologies, utilizing community-driven geographic data from OpenStreetMap and machine learning to enhance its offerings. The platform supports over 4 million developers and serves diverse industries, including logistics, automotive, retail, and travel.

Lone Wolf Technologies is a water and waste water treatment company with over 30 years of experience committed to serving industrial and commercial water and waste water treatment applications. We manufacture a complete line of proprietary water and waste water treatment chemicals that are specifically designed to enhance flows in cross flow filtration systems, self coagulate in clarification systems, and reduce the sludge generated by waste treatment operations. At Lone Wolf Technologies we combine the latest chemical and equipment technologies and engineer treatment systems that surpass your treatment needs. 

    Wastewater

There are many chemical and mechanical treatment methods as well as a laundry list of equipment available for treating and reusing wastewater. Matching the right chemistry with the right equipment is vitally important to making any system work. At Lone Wolf Technologies when we engineer a treatment system, we combine the best in chemical and mechanical systems that treat your wastewater and as well as provide ultra pure water for reuse.

    Boiler and Cooling Tower

Lone Wolf Technologies manufactures concentrated, application specific water treatment chemicals in solid form. Packaged in 1-gallon plastic bottles that are inverted and loaded into our small, wall mounted mix-on-site chemical feed systems. These demand driven systems automatically mix and refill, supplying chemicals to pumps. This combination of mixing systems and bottles replaces traditional chemical drums!

    Stabilization

Lone Wolf Technologies manufactures aqueous solutions for stabilizing precious and heavy metal ions in soils, waste treatment sludge, fly and bottom ash, foundry slag, mine tailings, incinerator ash, sediments and other solids to well below TCLP limits without increasing the volume of the material being stabilized. Lone Wolf Technologies products have been used to stabilize in the hazardous waste landfill and incinerator ash industries.

Talview also provides features tailored for healthcare recruitment and compliance.

Silvus Technologies, founded in 2004 and based in Los Angeles, CA, specializes in advanced Mobile-Networked MIMO (MN-MIMO) wireless communications systems for mission-critical applications. As a trusted Motorola Solutions company, Silvus has pioneered MIMO technology to enhance video, voice, and data transmission in challenging environments, including severe multipath and non-line-of-sight conditions.

The company develops MN-MIMO waveforms and mesh network systems that provide high throughput, range, and resilience against electronic warfare. Its primary product line, the StreamCaster family of MANET radios, has been in operation since 2011, offering reliable broadband wireless connectivity for military, defense, law enforcement, and emergency services. Silvus also provides comprehensive support services, including training and firmware upgrades, to ensure optimal product performance. With a strong focus on innovation, Silvus continues to advance its technology through ongoing research and development.

Healthcare Fraud Shield is a healthcare software company based in Chesterfield, MO, founded in 2011. The company specializes in AI-driven SaaS platforms designed to detect and prevent fraud, waste, abuse, and errors in healthcare claims for insurance payers. With over 20 years of expertise in claims fraud detection, Healthcare Fraud Shield offers advanced analytics, proprietary data fusion, and algorithms to deliver effective payment integrity solutions.

The core product, HCFSPlatform®, is an end-to-end solution that includes features like anomaly detection, medical record retrieval, and auditing. Key components of the platform include PreShield™ for pre-payment prevention, PostShield™ for post-payment analysis, and RecordPlus™ for AI-powered documentation insights. The company also provides specialized SIU services for proactive lead generation and case development. Healthcare Fraud Shield is committed to equipping healthcare payers with the technology and insights needed to enhance transparency and achieve cost savings.

ClearCaptions, LLC is a certified Internet Protocol Captioned Telephone Service (IP CTS) provider based in Roseville, California. Established in 2011, the company specializes in near real-time phone captioning services for individuals with hearing loss, particularly targeting hard-of-hearing seniors. Their services are provided at no cost to eligible U.S. registered users, funded through Title IV of the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA).

The company offers a range of products, including specially designed home phones for captioning, a mobile app for iPhone and iPad, and integration with office management software to streamline patient referrals for healthcare providers. ClearCaptions also supports FEMA Emergency Alert System notifications in certain areas. With a focus on quality, accountability, and customer satisfaction, ClearCaptions aims to enhance communication for older adults, helping them connect and live independently.

Biosero is a laboratory automation company based in San Diego, founded in 2003. It specializes in software and robotic solutions designed to streamline workflows in life sciences, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, and diagnostics. As a member of the BICO Group since 2021, Biosero shifted its focus in 2016 from third-party instrument sales to developing hardware-agnostic automation software. This enables scalable and adaptable lab orchestration to support scientific discovery.

The company's flagship product is the Green Button Go® platform, which includes the Green Button Go Scheduler for automating laboratory scheduling and the Green Button Go Orchestrator for managing end-to-end workflows. Biosero also offers custom integration and programming services for lab automation workcells, along with solutions for diagnostics, genomics, and drug discovery. With a commitment to enhancing research efficiency and improving human health, Biosero serves over 750 customers across more than 20 countries.

AEye's solutions cater to a wide range of markets, including automotive, aviation, drones, industrial applications, and smart infrastructure. The company has formed partnerships with major industry players, such as Continental, to validate its technology and expand its reach in both automotive and non-automotive sectors. With a team of around 100 employees, AEye is led by experienced professionals from the technology and automotive industries.

Sonatus serves major global automakers, powering over 6 million production vehicles from brands like Hyundai, Kia, and Genesis. With offices in key international locations, Sonatus is well-positioned to support the evolving automotive market. The company has raised over $110 million from prominent investors, including Foxconn and LG Electronics.

Founded in 2007, the company offers a suite of SaaS products designed to enhance patron engagement through user-friendly interfaces. BiblioCommons serves public libraries and consortia across the United States, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand, partnering with major library systems to enhance their online services.

Obsidian Entertainment is an American video game developer based in Santa Ana, California. Founded in June 2003 by former Black Isle Studios employees, the company specializes in creating role-playing games (RPGs). The studio is known for its focus on deep, choice-driven narratives and has built a strong reputation in the RPG genre. Celebrating its 20th anniversary in 2023, Obsidian continues to innovate and expand its portfolio of games, emphasizing player agency in its designs.

Versa Networks, based in Santa Clara, California, was founded in 2012 by Kumar Mehta and Apurva Mehta. The company specializes in Secure Access Service Edge (SASE), security, networking, SD-WAN, cloud, and analytics solutions. The core offering, Versa SASE, includes layered security for enterprises, full on-premises SASE for power branches, and managed SASE services for service providers. Versa Networks aims to help enterprises and service providers build agile and secure networks, enhancing connectivity for branches, home offices, and users globally. With a workforce of approximately 751 employees and an annual revenue of $137.8 million as of 2024, Versa serves thousands of customers and hundreds of thousands of sites worldwide through various channels.

Redwood Software is an enterprise automation company founded in 1993 in the Netherlands and now headquartered in Frisco, Texas. With over 550 employees, Redwood specializes in delivering automation solutions for mission-critical business processes, serving 40% of the Fortune 50. The company focuses on enabling "lights-out automation," which automates repetitive tasks to help organizations concentrate on strategic initiatives.

Redwood's comprehensive automation platform includes five key products: RunMyJobs for data management and IT service management, ActiveBatch and Tidal for workload automation, JSCAPE for managed file transfer solutions, Cerberus for secure file transfer, and Redwood Reporting for publishing and distributing reports. The company's solutions support critical business functions such as order-to-cash processes, procure-to-pay workflows, and SAP S/4HANA integration, with strong capabilities in integrating with SAP systems. Redwood has demonstrated strong financial performance and growth, adding numerous leading global enterprises to its customer base.

With access to extensive ad inventory and a commitment to efficiency, Rakuten Advertising serves leading global brands and connects them to billions of consumers.

The company specializes in providing solutions for equipment dealerships across various sectors, including agriculture, construction, heavy truck, material handling, forestry, mining, and sanitation. VitalEdge serves over 4,400 dealership rooftops worldwide and employs more than 800 associates. The company focuses on digital transformation and data intelligence, connecting dealership operations to enhance efficiency and customer satisfaction. Its core software offerings include the e-Emphasys ERP, which standardizes workflows and provides real-time analytics, and IntelliDealer, a comprehensive DMS that integrates various dealership functions. Key features of their solutions include OEM-aligned integrations, asset tracking, predictive maintenance, and enhanced customer experiences, all designed to support sustainable growth in the industries they serve.

Additionally, AutoRABIT provides Security Posture Management to continuously assess and mitigate security risks.

The platform supports various capabilities such as automated metadata deployment, advanced data loading, and defect tracking. AutoRABIT complies with industry standards, including SOC 2, HIPAA, and GDPR. The company is led by CEO Patrick Sweeney and SVP of Sales Phillip White, both of whom have extensive experience in cybersecurity and cloud infrastructure.

M-Files has evolved from a solution for small and medium-sized enterprises to specialized offerings for professional services, including legal, architecture, and consulting firms.

The company has experienced significant growth, achieving €120 million in revenue in 2023 and over $100 million in Annual Recurring Revenue. M-Files operates globally, with a U.S. headquarters in Austin, Texas, and maintains a strong Finnish identity. Its core platform focuses on organizing information by context and content, while its knowledge work automation solutions cater to various sectors, including engineering and construction. M-Files supports remote work and continues to expand its presence in the global market.

Airspan Networks Holdings Inc. is a telecommunications company based in Boca Raton, Florida. Founded in 1992, it specializes in software and hardware for 4G and 5G networks, focusing on Radio Access Network (RAN) technology, Open RAN solutions, and fixed wireless access. The company has a global presence, having shipped over one million cells to more than 1,000 customers across 100 countries.

Airspan's product offerings include compact base stations for network buildout, software-defined radios, and end-to-end Open RAN platforms that promote vendor interoperability. They also provide fixed wireless access solutions and network management software. The company emphasizes research and development to support mobile operators, large enterprises, and internet service providers, contributing to innovative 5G deployment. With a workforce of around 669 employees, Airspan generated approximately $176 million in revenue.

Their tools support workforce planning, program development in education, and economic activity analysis for governments.

Lightcast serves a diverse clientele, including enterprises focused on talent strategies, educational institutions designing programs, and government entities aiming for economic resilience. Their insights empower clients to navigate labor market complexities and make data-driven decisions.

Atari is a pioneering video game company founded in 1972 by Nolan Bushnell and Ted Dabney in Sunnyvale, California. It is known for revolutionizing the gaming industry with iconic arcade games and home video game consoles. Atari's early successes include the groundbreaking arcade game *Pong* and the popular home console Atari 2600, which sold millions of units. The company played a significant role in the golden age of arcade gaming and has continued to influence the industry for over 50 years.

Atari's product lineup includes classic arcade games like *Asteroids* and *Centipede*, as well as home consoles and computers. The company has also expanded into modern gaming, developing PC, console, and mobile games that leverage its well-known brands. Atari is committed to innovative leisure entertainment, focusing on quality and creativity in game development and publishing.

The company serves various markets, including carriers, enterprises, small and medium businesses, and government sectors, with applications in aviation, construction, and transportation.

The platform emphasizes quick setup, 24/7 support, and integrations with over 60 applications.

The platform supports agile and scalable solutions, allowing organizations to adapt to their operational needs while fostering continuous improvement. Tulip has received recognition as a Gartner Cool Vendor and has raised significant funding, reflecting its growth and impact in the industry.

These solutions connect physical items to the internet, enabling item-level visibility and automation for the Internet of Things (IoT). The company has a rich history, having launched its first commercial RFID products in 2005 and completing an initial public offering in 2016. Impinj has shipped over 5 billion units of its M800 series tag chips and tags more than a billion items weekly across various industries.

Impinj's core platform includes a range of RAIN RFID products such as endpoint ICs, readers, gateways, and software. These products facilitate the wireless connection of items to the cloud, supporting applications in supply chains, manufacturing, retail, and logistics. The company operates through a broad partner ecosystem, providing tools and support for customized RAIN RFID applications. Impinj is committed to innovation in sustainability and enhancing IoT experiences, positioning itself as a key player in the IoT landscape.

The company emphasizes a "consumer-first" approach and continues to innovate in the productivity space.

The company specializes in ultrafast fiber-optic Internet connectivity for businesses, operating its own fiber optic network primarily in NYC. Stealth offers Internet speeds ranging from 1 Gbps to 800 Gbps, utilizing advanced Wavelength Division Multiplexing (WDM) technology to provide dedicated wavelengths for each customer.

The company has a strong history of innovation, having been one of the first to join the IPv6 network and becoming a major IP customer for Sprint in NYC. Its offerings include Transparent LAN Service, peering and exchange services, and tailored solutions for government and defense clients. With a focus on high-speed connectivity and customer service, Stealth Communications is recognized as a leading provider in the region.

Conviva is a Silicon Valley-based company founded in 2006 that specializes in real-time performance analytics and operational data platforms for digital experiences. The company focuses on transforming fragmented digital signals from apps, websites, and AI agents into actionable insights that connect user behavior with business outcomes and system performance. Conviva's platform processes over 5 trillion events daily and supports a wide range of industries, including media, eCommerce, travel, and telecommunications.

The core offering is the Conviva Operational Data Platform, which provides consumer-perspective analytics. Key features include Video Streaming Insights for optimizing delivery and engagement, Digital Product Insights for linking user behavior to business performance, and Agentic Performance Insights for monitoring AI agent sessions. Conviva has powered major live events like the World Cup and the Super Bowl, and serves notable clients such as HBO, Disney, and ESPN. The company has raised over $99 million in funding and employs around 452 people.

Its clientele includes notable enterprises like Adobe, PayPal, and DocuSign, and it has established partnerships to enhance cloud infrastructure solutions.

Key features include the world's first AI-native automated testing tool, TrueTest, which adapts in real-time and supports data-driven testing. Katalon provides comprehensive services for web, mobile, desktop, and API testing, along with continuous integration and scalability for enterprises. The company has achieved significant growth and recognition, including being named one of America's fastest-growing software companies by Inc. 5000.

Foxit Software Company, founded in 2001 and headquartered in Fuzhou, China, is a leading provider of PDF and eSignature software solutions. The company has a global presence, with offices in the United States, Europe, Australia, and Asia. Foxit aims to deliver PDF software products that offer comparable functionality to Adobe's offerings at lower prices.

The company's primary products include Foxit Reader, a popular tool for viewing, creating, signing, and annotating PDF files; Foxit PhantomPDF, a comprehensive solution for PDF editing and creation; and the Foxit PDF Editor Suite, which allows users to manage documents across various platforms. Additionally, Foxit offers eSignature solutions and Software Developer Kits (SDKs) for integrating PDF technology into applications. With over 650 million users and more than 485,000 customers, Foxit has established strong partnerships with major technology companies and continues to grow, generating approximately $185 million in annual revenue.

Headquartered in Austin, Texas, with offices in London, Budapest, and Jakarta, SEON serves over 5,000 businesses globally across various sectors, including fintech, payments, eCommerce, and iGaming. The company focuses on preventing fraud losses through real-time detection using over 900 first-party data signals, explainable AI, and machine learning.

SEON offers a modular, API-first platform that enables rapid deployment for fraud prevention and financial crime detection. Key features include digital footprint analysis, real-time fraud monitoring, AML compliance solutions, and case management automation. The platform supports various use cases, such as onboarding fraud, account takeover, and transaction monitoring. SEON emphasizes transparency and flexibility, performing over 12 million fraud checks daily. Pricing starts at $699 per month, with a free 30-day trial available.

Pontera is a fintech company based in New York City, founded in 2012. It provides financial advisors with a secure software platform designed to manage, rebalance, and report on clients' held-away retirement accounts, such as 401(k)s, 403(b)s, and HSAs. The platform allows advisors to oversee these accounts without triggering custody issues, enhancing retirement outcomes for clients.

The company employs around 360 people and generates approximately $18.4 million in revenue. Pontera's platform offers tools for account connection and management, holistic portfolio integration, reporting and analytics, rebalancing and trading, as well as compliance and security features. These tools help advisors optimize asset allocation, improve portfolio visibility, and ensure regulatory compliance while reducing risks associated with non-custodied assets. Pontera collaborates with leading financial firms and partners with major financial institutions to expand its services.

With a workforce of 250-499 employees and an annual revenue of approximately $84.4 million, Vision Group Retail operates globally, serving customers in over 55 countries, including major global brands across various product categories.

AIO is an AI-driven technology company based in Raleigh, North Carolina, founded in 2022. The company provides a platform designed to enhance lending processes for banks, fintechs, non-banking financial institutions, brokers, and commercial lenders. AIO's platform focuses on real-time extraction, classification, validation, and analysis of financial documents, streamlining operations and reducing manual handling.

The core offerings include AIO Capture, which automates document capture and classification, and AIO Validate, which employs AI to validate data and detect errors. AIO also creates personal financial vaults for users, allowing for quick access to capital and efficient loan application management. The platform supports various sectors, including finance, insurance, and real estate, and aims to optimize workflows and improve communication between customers and lenders.

AIO's leadership team includes experienced professionals with backgrounds in technology and entrepreneurship. The company is backed by investors such as IDEA Fund Partners and Vocap Partners, focusing on early-stage growth while emphasizing user-controlled data privacy.

Valcom operates as a stand-alone entity under Potter Electric Signal, maintaining its brand and management.

Valcom serves a diverse range of markets, including higher education, healthcare, military, government, and industrial sectors, providing critical communication solutions tailored to meet the needs of its customers. The company employs approximately 145-178 people and reported revenue of $54.3 million.

ispace, inc. is a Japanese lunar exploration company founded in September 2010 and headquartered in Tokyo, with additional offices in Luxembourg and at NASA Ames Research Center. The company specializes in robotic spacecraft designed for low-cost, high-frequency transportation to the Moon, aiming to enable resource utilization and create a sustainable Earth-Moon ecosystem. ispace went public on the Tokyo Stock Exchange in 2023, marking Japan's first space company listing.

The company develops lunar landers and rovers, providing services such as high-frequency lunar transport, payload development for lunar missions, and the sale and survey of lunar surface data. ispace conducts commercial missions under the HAKUTO-R program and collaborates with various government space agencies, research institutions, and private companies. Their long-term vision includes supporting a lunar population and developing resources like lunar water for future exploration and habitation.

Aras Corporation is a product lifecycle management (PLM) software company based in Andover, Massachusetts. Founded in January 2000 by Peter Schroer, the company focuses on providing innovative solutions for managing product data throughout its lifecycle. The name "Aras" is derived from the founder's daughter, Sara, spelled backwards.

The company's flagship product, Aras Innovator, is a low-code PLM platform that has evolved since its introduction in 2001. It became the first fully functional web-native PLM platform in 2002 and features capabilities such as web services, CAD integration, requirements management, and 3D visualization. Aras Innovator is available in various deployment options, including on-premises and SaaS solutions, which launched in 2021.

Aras serves notable clients like Airbus, Microsoft, and BMW, and has expanded its global presence with offices in Switzerland, Germany, and France. The company has made strategic advancements, including a merger with Minerva Group and partnerships with AVEVA and SAIC, while also securing significant investments to support its growth.

EVA Airways Corporation, known as EVA Air, is a Taiwanese international airline established in March 1989 as a subsidiary of the Evergreen Group. It launched its first commercial flight on July 1, 1991, from Taoyuan International Airport. As Taiwan's second-largest airline, EVA Air operates a fleet of 89 aircraft, serving 65 destinations across Asia, Australia, Europe, and North America, with a focus on both passenger and cargo services. The airline has earned a 5-star Skytrax rating for its service quality.

EVA Air offers a range of passenger services, including First, Business, Premium Economy, and Economy classes. The airline operates a significant cargo service network, aiming for a balanced revenue mix between passenger and cargo operations. EVA Air primarily uses widebody aircraft, including models like the Boeing 767-300ER and Airbus A330-200. The airline continues to expand its international routes, connecting major cities worldwide and maintaining a strong emphasis on safety and service excellence.

The company is recognized for its innovative solutions and holds several accreditations, including ISO 9001 and SOC 2 Type II.

This family attraction is located at the entrance of The Island, located at 2757 Parkway, Pigeon Forge, TN. For more information, visit www.alcatrazeast.com.

Radformation is a healthcare technology company based in New York, founded in 2016. The company specializes in automation software for radiation oncology, aiming to enhance efficiency, reduce errors, and improve cancer treatment planning. Radformation develops AI-driven tools that standardize workflows and support higher patient throughput, ultimately enabling faster and safer radiation treatments for oncology clinics worldwide.

The company offers a suite of intelligent automation software that integrates with systems like Eclipse™ TPS. Key products include AutoContour, which auto-generates anatomical structures; ClearCheck, for automated treatment quality assurance; and ClearCalc, an independent calculation platform. Other offerings include ChartCheck for real-time patient data monitoring, EZFluence for automated 3D planning, QuickCode for billing accuracy, RadMachine for machine quality assurance, and RadMonteCarlo for Monte Carlo calculations. Radformation has achieved significant milestones, including over 1,400 clinic installations and regulatory clearances for several of its products.

Blue River Technology is an agricultural technology company founded in 2011 by Stanford graduates Jorge Heraud and Lee Redden. The company specializes in intelligent machinery that utilizes computer vision, machine learning, and robotics to promote sustainable farming practices. Its innovative solutions optimize chemical usage, automate processes, and enhance crop yields.

Headquartered in Santa Clara, California, Blue River Technology employs around 319 people and has raised over $20 million in funding. The company is known for its "see and act" systems, which include products like the LettuceBot, designed to automate lettuce thinning, and the See & Spray technology, which targets weeds in crops such as cotton and soybeans. In 2017, Blue River was acquired by John Deere for $305 million, allowing its technology to be integrated into Deere's equipment for broader deployment in the agricultural sector. The company is committed to addressing global sustainability challenges in agriculture through its advanced technologies.

The company specializes in unified identity and access management (IAM) solutions, effectively managing millions of identities for global enterprises, government entities, and multi-tenant SaaS providers. EmpowerID's comprehensive IAM suite is built on a single codebase and includes features such as role-based access control, user provisioning, identity governance, and privileged access management.

Zycus is a global provider of cognitive procurement software, headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey, with 11 offices worldwide. Founded in 1998, the company specializes in a comprehensive Source-to-Pay (S2P) suite powered by AI. Zycus has pioneered digital procurement solutions, evolving from its first digital catalog system to advanced AI-driven processes and now focusing on agentic AI transformation.

The company offers a SaaS-based S2P suite that includes tools for spend analytics, eSourcing, contract lifecycle management, supplier risk and performance management, eProcurement, and eInvoicing. Its Merlin AI Suite enhances procurement processes with AI agents for custom bots, cognitive decision-making, and data insights. Zycus serves over 500 leading brands, including General Electric, and is recognized as a leader in the industry by Gartner and Forrester. With approximately 1,614 employees, Zycus reported $301 million in annual revenue in 2024.

It serves over 45 energy suppliers and more than 2,100 registered brokers, facilitating significant B2B transactions in the energy marketplace.
